# Map to adult ref

```{r}
adult_counts_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/adult_ref_matrix.mtx"

adult_cells_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/adult_ref_cells.csv"

adult_features_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/adult_ref_features.csv"

adult_metadata_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/adult_ref_metadata.csv"


output_dir <- "output/objects"

# Number of PCs used for mapping
n_pcs <- 50

adult_counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = adult_counts_path,
  cells = adult_cells_path,
  features = adult_features_path,
  feature.column = 1
)



adult_metadata <- read.csv(
  adult_metadata_path,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

common_cells <- intersect(
  colnames(adult_counts),
  rownames(adult_metadata)
)



adult_counts <- adult_counts[, common_cells]

adult_metadata <- adult_metadata[
  common_cells,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


adult <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = adult_counts,
  meta.data = adult_metadata
)

rm(adult_counts, adult_metadata)

gc()

saveRDS(adult,"output/objects/adult_ref.RDS") # save for future use

adult <- SCTransform(
  adult,
  assay = "RNA",
  verbose = TRUE
)


adult <- RunPCA(
  adult,
  assay = "SCT",
  npcs = n_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)


adult <- RunUMAP(
  adult,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:n_pcs,
  return.model = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)


transfer_features <- intersect(
  rownames(adult[["SCT"]]),
  rownames(atlas[["SCT"]])
)

adult_anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = adult,
  query = atlas,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  features = transfer_features,
  dims = 1:n_pcs,
  verbose = TRUE
)

atlas_adult <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = adult_anchors,
  reference = adult,
  query = atlas,
  refdata = list(
    celltype = "cell_type"
  ),
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  reduction.model = "umap",
  verbose = TRUE
)


atlas_combined <- atlas

saveRDS(
  atlas_adult,
  file = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "atlas_mapped_adult_SCT.RDS"
  )
)
```

# Map to fetal ref

```{r}

fetal_counts_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/fetal_ref_matrix.mtx"

fetal_cells_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/fetal_ref_cells.csv"

fetal_features_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/fetal_ref_features.csv"

fetal_metadata_path <-
  "data/ref_rna_mapping/fetal_ref_metadata.csv"

output_dir <- "output/objects"

n_pcs <- 50


atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)


if ("peaksMACS2" %in% names(atlas@assays)) {
  
  message("Removing peaksMACS2 assay...")
  
  atlas[["peaksMACS2"]] <- NULL
}



fetal_counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = fetal_counts_path,
  cells = fetal_cells_path,
  features = fetal_features_path,
  feature.column = 1
)


fetal_metadata <- read.csv(
  fetal_metadata_path,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)



common_cells <- intersect(
  colnames(fetal_counts),
  rownames(fetal_metadata)
)


fetal_counts <- fetal_counts[, common_cells]

fetal_metadata <- fetal_metadata[
  common_cells,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]




fetal <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = fetal_counts,
  meta.data = fetal_metadata
)

rm(fetal_counts, fetal_metadata)

saveRDS(fetal,"output/objects/fetal_ref.RDS") # save for future use

gc()


set.seed(1234)

downsample_fraction <- 0.30

original_n_cells <- ncol(fetal)


cells_by_type <- split(
  Cells(fetal),
  fetal$cell_type
)


downsampled_cells <- unlist(
  lapply(
    cells_by_type,
    function(cells) {
      
      n_keep <- max(
        1,
        round(
          length(cells) *
            downsample_fraction
        )
      )
      
      sample(
        cells,
        size = n_keep,
        replace = FALSE
      )
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)




fetal <- subset(
  fetal,
  cells = downsampled_cells
)


message(
  "Percent retained: ",
  round(
    100 * ncol(fetal) / original_n_cells,
    1
  ),
  "%"
)





fetal <- SCTransform(
  fetal,
  assay = "RNA",
  vst.flavor = "v2",
  verbose = TRUE
)


fetal <- RunPCA(
  fetal,
  assay = "SCT",
  npcs = n_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)


fetal <- RunUMAP(
  fetal,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:n_pcs,
  return.model = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)


transfer_features <- intersect(
  rownames(fetal[["SCT"]]),
  rownames(atlas[["SCT"]])
)

fetal_anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = fetal,
  query = atlas,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  features = transfer_features,
  dims = 1:n_pcs,
  verbose = TRUE
)



atlas_fetal <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = fetal_anchors,
  reference = fetal,
  query = atlas,
  refdata = list(
    celltype = "CellClass"
  ),
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  reduction.model = "umap",
  verbose = TRUE
)

saveRDS(
  atlas_fetal,
  file = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "atlas_mapped_fetal_SCT_CellClass.RDS"
  )
)
```

```{r Ext 3d}
# Count cells by assigned Cell_Type and collapsed adult group
# get number of cells that mapped properly
atlas_adult_meta$Cell_Type <- as.character(atlas_adult_meta$Cell_Type)
atlas_adult_meta$sample_id <- as.character(atlas_adult_meta$sample_id)
atlas_adult_meta$predicted.celltype <- as.character(atlas_adult_meta$predicted.celltype)


count_df <- atlas_adult_meta %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cell_Type, predicted.celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

count_df$Cell_Type <- factor(count_df$Cell_Type, levels = rev(names(cellcolor)))
count_df$predicted.celltype <- factor(count_df$predicted.celltype, levels = names(adult_ref_colors))
p<-ggplot(
  count_df,
  aes(
    x = Cell_Type,
    y = n,
    fill = predicted.celltype
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = adult_ref_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Assigned Cell Type",
    y = "Number of cells",
    fill = "adult ref annotation"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
p
```

```{r}
predict_Postnatal<- atlas_adult_meta %>%
  subset(postnatal == "Postnatal") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cell_Type,predicted.celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = mean(predicted.celltype.score),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% data.frame()


highest_pred_postnatal<-count_df_postnatal %>% 
  group_by(Cell_Type) %>% 
  slice(which.max(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% data.frame()


highest_pred_postnatal$nCells_Cell_Type <- 0
highest_pred_postnatal$prediction_score <- 0
colnames(highest_pred_postnatal)[colnames(highest_pred_postnatal) == "n"] <- "nCells_predicted.celltype"
celltype_n_tbl<-atlas_adult_meta %>%
  subset(postnatal == "Postnatal") %>% 
  select("Cell_Type") %>% 
  table()
for (cell in highest_pred_postnatal$Cell_Type) {
  pred.cell <- highest_pred_postnatal[highest_pred_postnatal$Cell_Type == cell,"predicted.celltype"]
  highest_pred_postnatal$nCells_Cell_Type[highest_pred_postnatal$Cell_Type == cell] <- celltype_n_tbl[[cell]]
  highest_pred_postnatal$prediction_score[highest_pred_postnatal$Cell_Type == cell] <- predict_Postnatal[predict_Postnatal$Cell_Type == cell &
                                                                                                       predict_Postnatal$predicted.celltype == pred.cell,"n"]
}

highest_pred_postnatal$predicted.celltype_prop<-highest_pred_postnatal$nCells_predicted.celltype / highest_pred_postnatal$nCells_Cell_Type

rownames(highest_pred_postnatal) <- highest_pred_postnatal$Cell_Type

highest_pred_postnatal<-highest_pred_postnatal[,colnames(highest_pred_postnatal)[c(1,2,3,4,6,5)]]
write.csv(highest_pred_postnatal, "highest_predicted_adult_ref_postnatal.csv")



predict_Fetal<- atlas_adult_meta %>%
  subset(postnatal == "Fetal") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cell_Type,predicted.celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = mean(predicted.celltype.score),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% data.frame()


highest_pred_Fetal<-count_df_Fetal %>% 
  group_by(Cell_Type) %>% 
  slice(which.max(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% data.frame()


highest_pred_Fetal$nCells_Cell_Type <- 0
highest_pred_Fetal$prediction_score <- 0
colnames(highest_pred_Fetal)[colnames(highest_pred_Fetal) == "n"] <- "nCells_predicted.celltype"
celltype_n_tbl<-atlas_adult_meta %>%
  subset(postnatal == "Fetal") %>% 
  select("Cell_Type") %>% 
  table()
for (cell in highest_pred_Fetal$Cell_Type) {
  pred.cell <- highest_pred_Fetal[highest_pred_Fetal$Cell_Type == cell,"predicted.celltype"]
  highest_pred_Fetal$nCells_Cell_Type[highest_pred_Fetal$Cell_Type == cell] <- celltype_n_tbl[[cell]]
  highest_pred_Fetal$prediction_score[highest_pred_Fetal$Cell_Type == cell] <- predict_Fetal[predict_Fetal$Cell_Type == cell &
                                                                                                           predict_Fetal$predicted.celltype == pred.cell,"n"]
}

highest_pred_Fetal$predicted.celltype_prop<-highest_pred_Fetal$nCells_predicted.celltype / highest_pred_Fetal$nCells_Cell_Type

rownames(highest_pred_Fetal) <- highest_pred_Fetal$Cell_Type

highest_pred_Fetal<-highest_pred_Fetal[,colnames(highest_pred_Fetal)[c(1,2,3,4,6,5)]]
write.csv(highest_pred_Fetal, "highest_predicted_adult_ref_Fetal.csv")
```

```{r Ext 3e}
  ) %>% data.frame()
```

```{r}
highest_pred_fetal<-count_df_fetal %>% 
  group_by(Cell_Type) %>% 
  slice(which.max(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% data.frame()


highest_pred_fetal$nCells_Cell_Type <- 0
highest_pred_fetal$prediction_score <- 0
colnames(highest_pred_fetal)[colnames(highest_pred_fetal) == "n"] <- "nCells_predicted.celltype"

  subset(postnatal == "Fetal") %>% 
  select("Cell_Type") %>% 
  table()
for (cell in highest_pred_fetal$Cell_Type) {
  pred.cell <- highest_pred_fetal[highest_pred_fetal$Cell_Type == cell,"predicted.celltype"]
  highest_pred_fetal$nCells_Cell_Type[highest_pred_fetal$Cell_Type == cell] <- celltype_n_tbl[[cell]]
  highest_pred_fetal$prediction_score[highest_pred_fetal$Cell_Type == cell] <- predict_fetal[predict_fetal$Cell_Type == cell &
                                                                                               predict_fetal$predicted.celltype == pred.cell,"n"]
}

rownames(highest_pred_fetal) <- highest_pred_fetal$Cell_Type

highest_pred_fetal<-highest_pred_fetal[,colnames(highest_pred_fetal)[c(1,2,3,4,6,5)]]
write.csv(highest_pred_fetal, "highest_predicted_fetal.csv")
```
